summary: Final full E2E regression. Backend: test_hooklink_api.py 22/22 pass, test_platforms.py 21/21 pass (after I updated the outdated test that expected 200/empty for unknown platform; it now expects 422). Retested the 3 previous fixes and all pass: (a) refinement.html at 390px has scrollWidth=390 for all 7 platforms, and Publish is visible (right edge 253px); (b) applying a hook to a TikTok draft gives 'HOOK (0-3s): NEW HOOK ONE for tiktok', and that survives a reload; (c) /api/library?platform=bogus returns 422 and all 7 valid platforms return 200. UI happy path all passes: landing page links to /workspace.html; pick Instagram + topic + goal + tone, click generate, and you land on refinement with the Instagram badge, IG preview and char count 775/2,200; usage goes 5 to 4; Recent Drafts open and delete both work. On Refinement: an edit that is saved survives a reload; the desktop/mobile toggle changes canvas width (552/375); copy puts the edited text on the clipboard; refine tone (professional) rewrites the body; try-other-ideas swaps the hooks; the mock publish redirects to workspace. The YouTube preview shows 'Title Variations' and the youtube-title tracks line 1. Library: 8 then 30 ideas via load-more; category filters 8/7; platform filters tiktok 11, youtube 11, linkedin 18, all 30; search 'Harare' gives 4 and nonsense gives 0; copy works; newsletter shows 'Thanks for subscribing!', then 'You're already subscribed!', and an invalid email gets browser validation and an API 422. Rate limit: with count=5 the UI shows the 'Daily limit reached. Please come back tomorrow!' toast and stays on workspace. A failed provider not consuming quota is covered by pytest (passes). Privacy and terms pages return 200. No horizontal overflow at 390px on any page. No JS console errors, apart from the expected 429 network log.

issues: Copy is out of date. Terms section 2 says content is 'for LinkedIn' only. Privacy says text is used for 'LinkedIn hooks and posts' and that usage counts are kept in browser local storage, but the app now stores drafts and IP-based usage counts in the server database. These pages should be updated to cover all 7 platforms and the server-side storage of drafts and IP usage.

action_items: Update privacy.html and terms.html copy to cover multi-platform support and server-side storage of drafts and IP usage (content only, non-blocking)
critical_code_review_comments: The generate button is not disabled when 0 generations are left. The click still makes the request and gets a 429 toast. Optionally disable it or show a hint when remaining is 0.
